== Biography ==
Lillias was born about 1843. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1574|Alexander Glasgow]] and [[Baigrie-28|Ann Baigrie]].

She married George Williamson on 21 Sep 1866 in Midlothian, Scotland.
